lines.text: We saw the lighthouse at sunset. And it was *dark.*
lines.style: First-person survivor, feverish and out of breath, hoarse, a hollow drop of disbelief on the last word.

lines.text: Mia carried half my weight the last five *miles.*
lines.style: Narrating weakly, sick with fever, ashamed and grateful, slow.
Narrating, hushed, uneasy, a cold beat on the last word.

lines.text: Empty beds. No one. Just a radio, still *talking.*
lines.style: Narrating in a whisper in an abandoned room, short pauses between phrases, dread growing.

lines.text: This is Gull Point. The lighthouse is a safe zone. We keep the lights on at night.
lines.style: A calm, tired man reading an emergency radio message that repeats on a loop, clear and steady, slightly mechanical.

lines.text: It's a recording. It's been playing for *months.*
lines.style: Teenage girl, quiet and numb, realising all hope was a lie, voice catching on the last word.
Narrating, empty and broken, slow, almost a whisper.

lines.text: In the mirror, my eye flickered *green.*
lines.style: Narrating, feverish, frightened and very quiet, a shiver on the last word.
Teenage girl at a window, terrified whisper, trembling, a long pause after the name.

lines.text: Mia didn't see my eyes. Biscuit *did.*
lines.style: Narrating, low and haunted, a slow pause before the last two words.

music.title: Last Light - Gull Point
music.style: Cinematic post-apocalyptic score. Opens on a weary, aching theme: low cello, soft wind-like pads and a slow heartbeat pulse, like the end of a long walk at sunset. Turns hollow and eerie in an abandoned place: sparse detuned piano, faint radio-like hum. A creeping dread builds with low strings and a ticking pulse, ending on a dark, tense swell. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
